_about: The Birch and the Star, and Other Stories (Row, Peterson, 1915): stories by Jørgen Moe and Zacharias Topelius, given in English by Gudrun Thorne-Thomsen. The title page reads 'By Gudrun Thorne-Thomsen' and the book names no other translator; her foreword says the stories were written in Norwegian and Swedish.
